notes.title: Event for the start of season 2
notes.notes:
Season 1 is ending soon to make way for season 2 :)

We have decided to offer you a new event to start the new season.
The event will be available when Season 2 kicks off (For your first season login).



Season 2 begins on April 03, 2021.
Every day (from March 27), teasers will be available on Twitter until the launch of the new season.


Hype?

notes.title: Steam pricing issue resolved!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, since the game was released we have had issues with pricing on steam but this is now resolved!

You can now buy the game without price issues ;)

Have a good day!

notes.title: The show !
notes.notes:
[i][u][b]Hello, February 27 will be the first in-game event.[/b][/u][/i]


We do not tell you the content of the event to keep the surprise;)


Here's how to participate in the event:

[b]- Log in to the game before 19:00 (GMT).

- From 18:55 (GMT), the "EVENT" game mode will be available (You just have to click on PLAY).

- If you are in a game, it will automatically teleport you to the event.
[/b]

[b][i][u]Appointment on February 27 at 19:00 (GMT) to attend the event :)[/u][/i][/b]

notes.title: Update Details v.002
notes.notes:
[i][b]Before telling you about the show, here are the new features of the v.002 update :[/b][/i]


[b]- New Menu
- New Outfit
- First temporary game mode (One Door)
- New menu settings (To modify the sounds)
- Bugs Fixes
[/b]

And more...



[i][b]Finally, get ready for the show on February 27th.

We can not tell you more at the moment (See you in a few days for more information)[/b][/i]

notes.title: V.001
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to the post to know some information on this first version.



[b]Release date :[/b]


See you on February 12 to access the first version of the game.




[b]The shop:[/b]


The shop will not be available upon release of the game but upon the release of season 1.




[b]Season 1 date :[/b]


At the moment, the date for Season 1 is not yet available. But we are working on version 0.002 which will add a lot of new features :)




[u][b]Prepare yourself because there are only 10 days left before the start of the first version ;)[/b][/u]
